minor.issue: Exception documents return payment_id: null for CSV exceptions (only record_ref carries the identifier). Cosmetic/API-shape inconsistency, not blocking.

ui_bugs.issue: REGRESSION 6 not fixed correctly. `sigResult` state is set in testInvalidSignature() but is NEVER rendered anywhere in the JSX (grep: 'sigResult' appears only at the useState declaration). Clicking 'Test invalid signature' fires POST /api/simulate/invalid-signature-test (200) and then produces NO card, toast or any visible feedback — the previous 'REJECTED — HTTP 401' evidence card was deleted instead of moved below the simulated-event card. Also testInvalidSignature() has no try/catch, so a failure would be a silent unhandled rejection.

issues: REGRESSION 4 only partially fixed. Hamburger (mobile-menu-btn) opens the drawer, X closes it, KPI text wraps correctly — but the whole page still scrolls horizontally: documentElement.scrollWidth = 511px on Dashboard, 652px on /ingest, 844px on /events (viewport 390). Culprits: wide <table class='w-full text-sm'> blocks and the Dashboard filter row (div.flex.items-center.gap-3 containing the status <select>) are not wrapped in an overflow-x-auto container. /review is correct (scrollWidth = 390) — apply the same wrapper pattern to the Dashboard cases table, Ingest 'Recent Batches' table, Events webhook-events table, and the Events endpoint <code> URL (405px wide).

Banner says '4 rows sent to the exception queue' but the ROW/ERRORS table below lists only 3 rows (9 invalid_amount, 10 unsupported_status, 12 missing_linkage). The duplicate row (row 11, duplicate_payment_id) is counted but not listed, so the numbers appear inconsistent to the user.

action_items: HIGH: Render the invalid-signature result in Events.jsx (a card using sigResult, placed AFTER the sim-event-result card, with a data-testid such as invalid-sig-result) and wrap testInvalidSignature in try/catch with a toast on failure. Currently the button silently does nothing.

Wrap the remaining wide tables/filter row in overflow-x-auto (Dashboard cases table + filter row, Ingest Recent Batches, Events webhook events table, webhook URL code block) to remove the 121–454px page-level horizontal overflow at 390px.
Ingest validation report: also list the duplicate row in the ROW/ERRORS table (or footnote it) so the '4 rows sent to the exception queue' count matches the visible rows.
critical_code_review_comments: Events.jsx: dead state — `sigResult`/`setSigResult` are written but never read/rendered; ESLint does not flag it because the setter is used. This is exactly the class of bug that makes a button look broken.
Events.jsx testInvalidSignature() is the only async handler without try/catch — no error state for a demo-critical security control.
Layout.jsx close button had no data-testid (added mobile-menu-close-btn during this run).

Ingest polling implementation is correct: 202 + GET /api/ingest/{batch_id} poll, visible 'Importing in background' state, terminal statuses handled; no gateway timeout observed (report rendered ~35s after confirm).

rca_of_the_issue: Regression 6: the fix intended to move the invalid-signature rejection card below the simulated-event card, but the JSX block that consumed `sigResult` was removed and never re-added, leaving orphan state. Result: the POST still succeeds (200) yet the UI renders nothing, which reads as a dead button. Regression 4: the layout fix added the mobile top bar/hamburger and made the sidebar translate off-canvas, but wide data tables and the dashboard filter row were not given horizontal scroll containers, so document scrollWidth still exceeds the 390px viewport (511/652/844px).
